meta.title: Typle | Learn the words you want by typing them
meta.description: A free typing app for learning programming commands and syntax as well as words in other languages. Practice with {total} official lists or your own word lists, no login needed.

hero.title: Learn the words you want by typing them.
hero.lead: Typle is a typing app that lets you practice with your own word lists or official packs. Pick up programming commands and syntax, or words in another language, as you type.

packs.title: Official packs
packs.lead: Follow any of {total} official lists and start practicing right away.

programming.title: Programming
programming.text: Syntax for Go, Java, Kotlin, TypeScript and more, commands for Linux, Vim, the AWS CLI and more, and PostgreSQL error codes.

languages.title: Languages
languages.text: Words and phrases in Chinese (HSK levels 5 and 6), Korean, English, French, German, Spanish, Russian and Czech. Chinese and Korean can also be practiced by handwriting.

own.title: Practice with your own word lists
own.text: Add the words you want to learn and practice them. The word shown and the characters typed can differ, and you can import from CSV or TSV files.

recall.title: Type from memory
recall.text: A mode that hides the answer and shows the note as a hint, so you can check whether you really remember each word.

records.title: See your progress
records.text: Speed, accuracy and mistakes are recorded every time, so your personal bests and trends show how far you have come.

storage.title: Where your data is kept
storage.text: Every feature works without logging in. Your data is kept in this browser, and logging in with GitHub syncs it across devices.
